note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Guinea: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Social security contributions are 23% of pay between a floor of GNF 550,000 and a ceiling of GNF 2,500,000 a month: 18% from the employer and 5% from the employee, the employer paying both shares to the CNSS by the 15th after the month or quarter.
figures.applies: Salaried workers; the self-employed regime is not stated on this page.

sources.said: Le plafond est de 2 500 000 GNF Le plancher est de 550 000 GNF Le taux des cotisations sociales Il représente 23% du salaire soumis à cotisation. Ce taux de financement est reparti ainsi qu’il suit : Employeur 18% Salarié 5% … Prestations familiales 6% Accident du travail et Maladies professionnelles 4% Assurance maladies 6,5% Retraite Vieillesse Invalidité Décès 6,5% … Le versement des cotisations se fait dans les quinze (15) premiers jours qui suivent le mois ou le trimestre échu

figures.finding: A provider with no tax domicile in Guinea (no Guinean tax number) has 15% withheld at source on non-salary income paid to it, on the gross amount billed before VAT (General Tax Code, art. 198); Enabel states it is not applied to residents of the countries with a double-tax agreement with Guinea (France, Morocco and Tunisia, as of 2025). Whether the withholding is final was not found stated.

value.appliesTo: non-salary income of a provider without a Guinean NIF (no tax domicile in Guinea)

figures.applies: Guinea, as applied in June 2025 by Enabel (the Belgian development agency) in a public tender; the CGI's own text was not reached (mbudget.gov.gn HTTP 403).
figures.searched: Web search 2026-11-02: 'Guinée Conakry retenue à la source prestations de services non-résidents taux libératoire droits d'auteur TVA 18% seuil d'assujettissement chiffre d'affaires' returned trykintsugi.com, rivermate, CMS (2016-17), financialafrik.com, copeps.fr and Enabel's tender Q&A (read: this finding).

sources.said: Il sera retenu à la source 15 % sur les revenus non-salariaux (Art. 198 du Code général des impôts) si le prestataire ne possède pas de NIF en Guinée (= contractant sans domicile fiscal en Guinée). … Cependant, si le soumissionnaire a son siège fiscal dans un pays ayant conclu un accord de non-double imposition avec la Guinée (actuellement la France, le Maroc et la Tunisie), cette retenue ne sera pas appliquée. … Le taux de la retenue est fixé à quinze pourcent (15%) du montant brut des sommes versées. Le montant brut est le montant facturé hors Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA).
